chunks: He shows you His signs. So which of God's signs will you deny?
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God asks 'which of His signs will you deny?'
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ghafir, this verse underscores the comprehensiveness of divine revelation, challenging humanity's selective denial of God's proofs. Shia scholarship often interprets 'His signs' as encompassing both the natural world and the Ahl al-Bayt, serving as the ultimate criteria for recognizing truth amidst the surah's theme of divine forgiveness for those who reflect.
